lines.text: Amma Nanna 30th anniversary… cake cut చేయబోతుంటే — TL call!
lines.say: [excited] Amma Nanna thirtieth anniversary… [dramatic pause] cake cut చేయబోతుంటే — [whispers] TL call!
lines.act: a lively narrator dropping the viewer into the moment, then a hushed, doom-laden whisper on the last two words

lines.text: Nikhil, జర పది నిమిషాలే… client escalation. ఆ module నీకే తెల్సు!
lines.say: [hurried] Nikhil, జర పది నిమిషాలే… [insistent] client escalation. ఆ module నీకే తెల్సు!

lines.text: పది నిమిషాలు… ఎప్పుడూ పది కాదు. Nikhil ఏం చేశాడో… చివర్లో!
lines.say: [laughs] పది నిమిషాలు… ఎప్పుడూ పది కాదు. [mischievously] Nikhil ఏం చేశాడో… [whispers] చివర్లో!
lines.act: a knowing chuckle shared with every office-goer, then a sly teasing whisper

lines.text: నీకిష్టమని pulihora చేశా… ఆ phone కింద పెట్టు!
lines.say: [warmly] నీకిష్టమని pulihora చేశా… [annoyed] ఆ phone కింద పెట్టు!

lines.text: Appraisal వచ్చే నెల… boot లో laptop… just in case.
lines.say: [thoughtful] Appraisal… వచ్చే నెల. [quietly] boot లో laptop… [sighs] just in case.
lines.act: calm inner voice weighing it up, a small guilty sigh on the last words

lines.text: Office గోల… Friday family group లో కూడా 'runbook' పంపావ్!
lines.say: [sighs] Office గోల… [annoyed] Friday family group లో కూడా runbook పంపావ్!
lines.act: an exasperated mother complaining to the relatives, half laughing; stress on family group

lines.text: ఇలాంటి office dilemmas కావాలంటే… follow చేయండి!
lines.say: [warmly] ఇలాంటి office dilemmas కావాలంటే… [excited] follow చేయండి!

lines.text: మీరైతే? A… call తీస్తారు. B… switch off. Comment చేయండి!
lines.say: [dramatic pause] మీరైతే? A… call తీస్తారు. B… switch off. [excited] Comment చేయండి!
lines.act: a slow, personal question to the viewer, then urgent quiz-host energy

lines.text: Sir, Friday నే Kiran కి runbook ఇచ్చా… step 4!
lines.say: [calmly] Sir, Friday నే Kiran కి runbook ఇచ్చా… [confidently] step four!
lines.act: cool and unhurried, a tiny smile in the voice; stress on Friday

lines.text: అరె… Kiran fix చేసిండు! నిజంగా పది నిమిషాలే!
lines.say: [surprised] అరె… Kiran fix చేసిండు! [laughs] నిజంగా పది నిమిషాలే!

lines.text: పని ఒక్కడికే తెలిస్తే… వాడికి Sunday ఉండదు రా.
lines.say: [chuckles] పని ఒక్కడికే తెలిస్తే… [slowly] వాడికి Sunday ఉండదు రా.

lines.text: మీ office లో ఇలా జరిగిందా? Comment… office friend కి పంపండి!
lines.say: [mischievously] మీ office లో ఇలా జరిగిందా? Comment… [excited] office friend కి పంపండి!

lines.text: Team lead కి మాత్రం కాదు! Follow… అరె, మళ్ళీ phone!
lines.say: [laughs] Team lead కి మాత్రం కాదు! [warmly] Follow… [gasps] అరె, మళ్ళీ phone!
lines.act: a laughing warning, a warm sign-off cut short by a startled gasp

visual_plan: style: CLAY skin for the family home (warm afternoon light, plasticine look: marigold garland on the door, a steel plate of yellow pulihora, the 2-tier cake with a '30 ❤️' topper, relatives around a dining table in a Kukatpally flat). setSkin('neon') ONLY for the office side: Suresh's call panel (L2, L10) and the A half of the split (L8) — cold blue glow, red 'P1 ESCALATION' dashboard. Cast looks per tools/anim2d/cast.md: Nikhil (NIKHIL_OPT, charcoal shirt). New: Saroja (Amma, ~55, silk saree, specs on a chain, phone always in hand), Prasad (Nanna, ~60, retired, white shirt, grey moustache, calm half-smile, mostly silent in the corner until L11), Suresh (TL, ~40, headset, rolled sleeves, two monitors behind him). Optional silent cameo: Ananya (teal kurta) at the table with a plate of pulihora. Kiran (junior, ~23) appears only as a chat avatar / on-call screen, no voice.

L1 hook (0 s, open on the action, no title yet): top-down clay shot — the '30 ❤️' cake, Amma and Nanna's hands together on the knife; Nikhil's phone face-up beside the cake VIBRATING (shake + buzz SFX), screen: 'Suresh (TL) calling… · Sun 1:02 PM'. Relatives freeze mid-clap. Title 'A or B? 🤔' + pill 'MODERN DILEMMA' and text hook 'Anniversary lunch… TL calling! 📞' a beat later (~1.5 s).

L2 call: setSkin('neon') hard cut to Suresh in a dark office, sweating, dashboard 'P1 ESCALATION · Payments module'. REWATCH CLUE: a small roster card on his second monitor reads 'On-call today: Kiran (new)'. A chip '10 mins' pops above the phone.
L3 hold: back to clay. The '10 mins' chip CRACKS and re-forms as '2 hrs' (glass-crack SFX); a clock on the wall spins. Gopi corner cut-out winks; tag 'NIKHIL ఏం చేశాడో… చివర్లో 👀' stamps on.
L4 option-b: Amma slides the steel plate of pulihora in front of Nikhil and points at the phone; relatives' heads turn in unison toward him.

L5 option-a: quick clay cut-away to the parked car downstairs: the boot pops open by itself, a laptop bag inside with a glowing 'just in case' halo; a calendar card 'Appraisal · Dec' flips up next to Nikhil's head.

L6 plant (KEY REWATCH CLUE, shown ~1.5 s, readable but not zoomed): Amma holds up her phone — the 'Family ❤️ (47)' WhatsApp group. Visible messages: 'Fri 6:42 PM · Nikhil: Kiran — payments module runbook, step 1–7 📄' (sent to the wrong group), 'Mavayya: Printed 👍 ఏంటి బాబు ఇది?', 'Pinni: 😂😂'. Nikhil winces. It must read as a joke (wrong-group message), not as a hint.
L7 follow: animated FOLLOW button pressed by a finger (pop SFX); the vibrating phone freezes mid-buzz.

L8 comment-countdown: hard split-screen — LEFT (neon) 'A · Call తీయాలి': Nikhil on the car boot with the laptop open, the '10 mins' chip turning into '2 hrs', through the window the family cutting the cake without him. RIGHT (clay) 'B · Switch off': phone face-down beside the pulihora, the 'Appraisal · Dec' card shaking. Big ticking clock between them; 'మీరైతే A or B? 💬' + 5 s countdown 5-4-3-2-1 (no voice during the 5 s, clock-tick SFX). Comment bubbles float up — none hint at the runbook or Kiran: 'A — appraisal ముఖ్యం bro', 'B — Sunday is Sunday!', '10 mins అంటే 3 hrs 😂', 'Boot లో laptop… too real 💀', 'A, client wait చేయడు', '🤔'.

L9 reveal: neither panel wins — the split snaps shut. Nikhil takes the call for a few seconds (call timer '00:24'), relaxed, a fork of pulihora in the other hand. On 'runbook' the L6 family-group message flashes back over the frame for 6 frames (the clue paying off). Cut to Kiran's on-call screen: runbook 'Step 4' highlighted, cursor clicks.
L10 payoff: Suresh's neon dashboard flips 'P1 ESCALATION' → green 'RESOLVED'; the cracked '2 hrs' chip snaps back to a clean '10 mins ✅' (ding SFX). The neon glow warms into clay as we return home.
L11 take: Nanna, from his corner, chuckles; he and Amma cut the cake; Nikhil puts the phone face-down. Quick insert: the car boot downstairs closes on the laptop. Music drops to a single warm note.
L12 comment-share: text 'మీ office లో ఇలా జరిగిందా? 💬' then a share-arrow animation sending the reel to a contact card 'Office bestie ☕' — a contact card 'Team Lead' slides up and gets a red ✕.

L13 close-loop: end card FOLLOW @_REELRASAM · SUBSCRIBE @REEL_RASAM; on 'మళ్ళీ phone' the phone on the cake table starts vibrating again ('Suresh (TL) calling…') — hard cut to frame 1 so the loop is seamless.
